$comment: The credential names and redaction tokens both redactors read (contracts §13, ADR 0025 Redaction; 2.1-M434): bindings-gen emits desktop/web/src/generated/redaction.ts and canopi-redact/src/table_generated.rs from this file. A name matches case-insensitively as a query or form parameter (`name=value`) and as a JSON key (`"name": "value"`); its value becomes the redacted token. A new name comes only through the Phase 1 owners file. `known_extensions` are the file types Canopi reads or writes: an unquoted path whose last word before a `path: reason` pair's colon ends in one of them ends there, so the reason is kept; any other dot may sit inside a folder name, so an unknown type costs the reason's words, never a leaked name.
